title: Plasma proteome profiles in progressive prostate cancer states and development of composite prognostic stratification scores in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
snippet: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC) is a biologically heterogeneous disease with variable survival outcomes.
